name: Prediction Error Signals Feed Mesolimbic Dopamine
description: Cross-framework template linking predictive processing with reward systems. Prediction error magnitude directly modulates VTA dopamine release, providing reward signals that reinforce learning.

key_references.citation: Schultz, W., Dayan, P., & Montague, P. R. (1997). A neural substrate of prediction and reward. Science, 275(5306), 1593-1599.
Salimpoor, V. N., et al. (2011). Anatomically distinct dopamine release during anticipation and experience of peak emotion to music. Nature Neuroscience, 14(2), 257-262.
Bromberg-Martin, E. S., Matsumoto, M., & Hikosaka, O. (2010). Dopamine in motivational control: Rewarding, aversive, and alerting. Neuron, 68(5), 815-834.

causal_links.mechanism_summary: Prediction error magnitude computed in cortex drives VTA dopamine neuron firing
Dopamine release generates reward/motivation signals; sign depends on prediction violation direction
Reward signals reinforce approach behavior and learning of predictive cues
